name: radiology-skills
description: 影像科研全链路技能包：40 个 radiology-* 技能，覆盖立题、运行治理、影像测量、分析、证据综合、健康经济学、科研传播、创新转化、标书/PPT与投稿审阅（Radiology/Nature 双规格）。

author.name: Huang Yuhong, Gu Wenchao, Song Xinyang

interface.longDescription: Forty coordinated skills for evidence-bounded radiology research: governance and operations, acquisition and analysis, evidence synthesis, reproducibility, consensus, qualitative and economic evaluation, grants, presentations, dissemination, innovation transfer, writing, review, submission and post-publication stewardship.
interface.developerName: Huang Yuhong, Gu Wenchao, Song Xinyang
defaultPrompt: Route this radiology research task to the narrowest appropriate skill.
Freeze the acquisition, reconstruction, and quantitative-imaging QC passport before analysis.
Audit this study while preserving evidence and claim boundaries.
Plan the next traceable gate for this imaging research project.
Review this imaging grant against the live call and return criterion-level closure actions.
Build an audience-specific, source-grounded radiology research deck and report each QA receipt.
Route integrity, operations, reproducibility, impact and post-publication work to their unique owners.
